title: OpenAI tweaks model spec guidelines to 'understand human intentions and values'
summary: OpenAI tweaks model spec guidelines to 'understand human intentions and values'
detailed:
OpenAI OPENAI on Thursday tweaked the guidelines for its artificial intelligence model specifications, allowing the models to better “understand human intentions and values.”
The update is now focused on five values, OpenAI explained: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.
“This reflects an aim of our work on value alignment: for models to understand and apply human values in unfamiliar situations, while remaining faithful to human intent,” OpenAI said on its website.

“It also means recognizing that people’s beliefs and values can change, and helping them reflect and grow in ways they would endorse without quietly steering them or overriding their choices.”
Aside from further detail on the new spec guidelines, OpenAI said it was retiring most of the spec’s detailed style guidance and was adding a new section on faithfulness to human intent.
The company said the update is just the first step in making the values and reasoning behind the spec more explicit as models become more capable.

OpenAI OPENAI on Thursday tweaked the guidelines for its artificial intelligence model specifications, allowing the models to better “understand human intentions and values.”

“This reflects an aim of our work on value alignment: for models to understand and apply human values in unfamiliar situations, while remaining faithful to human intent,” OpenAI said on its website.

The ChatGPT maker can write the spec, set the boundaries, and train the models to respect them, while the developers can direct apps to act within the boundaries, and the users can tell the models to work within those parameters.

“Faithfulness means going beyond following instructions literally to deeply understanding what OpenAI, developers, and users intend and value, and acting wisely when that understanding is incomplete,” OpenAI added.

“It also means recognizing that people’s beliefs and values can change, and helping them reflect and grow in ways they would endorse without quietly steering them or overriding their choices.”
Aside from further detail on the new spec guidelines, OpenAI said it was retiring most of the spec’s detailed style guidance and was adding a new section on faithfulness to human intent.
The company said the update is just the first step in making the values and reasoning behind the spec more explicit as models become more capable.
